usa.title: Donations from USA
usa.description: For donors in the USA, contributions can be made through ASHA Boston, which provides the added benefit of tax exemptions in the USA. ASHA does not charge any fees for processing these transactions. Once you have made your contribution, please inform us via email so that we can ensure timely follow-up.
